charge_spark.note: spark_0 at the start of the charge, spark_2 held at full charge (armored); drawn at the frame's tip point, in its own colours (spark-amber, the full charge in husk-core inside its ring)

chain.note: one link per 14 sheet px from the hand to the hook (the Haul's 224 world px in 16 links); on a hit every link swaps to taut for the pull

hook.note: the Hookblade's head pointing right, rotate to the throw angle; origin is the shank end where the chain ties on, in sheet px
